run_broadcast_test_integer: run the broadcast_test function to broadcast an integer value from root process 0 to all MPI processes
run_broadcast_test_string: run the broadcast_test function to broadcast a string value from root process 0 to all MPI processes
run_broadcast_test_list: run the broadcast_test function to broadcast a list of strings from root process 0 to all MPI processes
test_mpi_broadcast_root_one: test the mpi.broadcast function by broadcasting a value from root process 1 to all processes in the communicator
review_broadcast_test: review the broadcast_test function that uses mpi.broadcast to send values from a root process to all processes in a communicator
